mild-aprilvins.summary: Pairs a manipulation-localization benchmark with AprilTag-aided fisheye VIO and guarded TCP-trajectory export.
mild-aprilvins.input: Calibrated fisheye images, IMU, known tag identities/sizes and sensor-to-TCP transform
mild-aprilvins.output: Guarded body/TCP trajectory in a sequence-local tag map; MILD benchmark comparisons
mild-aprilvins.robotEvidence: 86 real sensor sequences / 15 tabletop tasks and 9 Isaac Sim sequences; robot-executed TCP reference, not external MoCap. Main AprilTag4 route reports error, time completion and timestamp gaps jointly.
mild-aprilvins.outputRepresentation: SE(3) body/TCP poses, velocity and IMU biases; sequence-local tag layout

mild-aprilvins.scale: Known tag sizes plus inertial estimation; benchmark uses SE(3) alignment without scale fitting

mild-aprilvins.robotPlatform: Capture / reconstruction reference; no robot policy claim
mild-aprilvins.implementation: Fisheye unit-sphere tag residuals; VIO sliding window; tag-prior admission gate; guarded continuation before output
mild-aprilvins.limitations: Preprint; code/data/manifests promised after acceptance. Profiles are sequence-specific under a shared rule set. Route-specific recordings are diagnostic comparisons, not a matched universal ranking.

robocap-grounded.summary: Combines multi-camera inertial tracking, per-session calibration and offline global refinement for egocentric capture.
robocap-grounded.input: Synchronized multi-camera images and IMU with factory calibration; report uses a six-camera global-shutter research rig
robocap-grounded.output: Head trajectory, registered scene/depth and multi-view hand estimates through the Grounded API stack
robocap-grounded.robotEvidence: LaMAria held-out control-point evaluation plus EuRoC, TUM-VI, Monado and Aria recordings. ADT/HOT3D agreement is against Aria MPS pseudo-reference, not independent absolute accuracy.
robocap-grounded.outputRepresentation: Metric gravity-aligned SE(3) trajectory, landmarks and downstream 3D products
robocap-grounded.coordinateFrame: Gravity-aligned SLAM world; separate cross-session RANSAC alignment
robocap-grounded.scale: Overlapping stereo baselines and inertial measurements; monocular cameras add coverage
robocap-grounded.temporal: Causal sliding-window estimate during capture; reported final poses use offline full-keyframe visual-inertial BA
robocap-grounded.evaluation: LaMAria held-out control-point evaluation plus EuRoC, TUM-VI, Monado and Aria recordings. ADT/HOT3D agreement is against Aria MPS pseudo-reference, not independent absolute accuracy.
robocap-grounded.robotPlatform: Capture / reconstruction reference; no robot policy claim
robocap-grounded.implementation: GPU patch optical flow, square-root window estimator, place recognition, divergence resets and offline VI bundle adjustment
robocap-grounded.limitations: Long self-similar loops and very fast rotation remain difficult. Causal poses are about twice as inaccurate as final offline poses in the report. No downstream policy-performance measurement. Retail rolling-shutter RoboCap specifications must not be substituted for the paper rig.

slam.metricScale: Stereo baseline plus inertial scale

ha-slam.summary: Adapts feature matching, stereo-inertial estimation and global refinement to fast natural head motion.

ha-slam.robotEvidence: Author-reported evaluation on 8 indoor natural-head-motion segments with MoCap reference; raw/gap-adjusted ATE and completeness. The visible difficulty table lists only seven segment IDs.

ha-slam.scale: Stereo geometry and independent inertial scale are compared for per-recording correction
ha-slam.temporal: Frontend and backend tracking followed by global bundle adjustment; published runtime/latency is not verified
ha-slam.evaluation: Author-reported evaluation on 8 indoor natural-head-motion segments with MoCap reference; raw/gap-adjusted ATE and completeness. The visible difficulty table lists only seven segment IDs.
ha-slam.robotPlatform: Capture / reconstruction reference; no robot policy claim
ha-slam.implementation: Custom learned extraction/matching; stereo-inertial backend; global BA; cross-modal metric self-calibration
ha-slam.limitations: Commercial self-reported technical report; dataset, code and weights are not publicly verified. Do not generalize the small internal benchmark or repeat the claim of universal superiority. Segment-count inconsistency remains visible in the report.

slam.metricScale: Stereo baseline plus inertial scale self-calibration
slam.captureRelevance: Explicitly designed for egocentric robot-training data; internal benchmark rather than an independently reproduced result.
slam.calibration: Hardware image/IMU synchronization, stereo calibration and cross-modal metric self-calibration.

vidmap.summary: Uses temporal tracks, provenance-aware loop constraints and learned depth priors for offline reconstruction of long videos.
vidmap.input: Ordered monocular RGB video; calibrated or unknown camera intrinsics
vidmap.output: Keyframe poses, estimated intrinsics and sparse 3D map
vidmap.supervision: Pretrained dense matching and monocular-depth/focal priors combined with multi-view geometry
vidmap.robotEvidence: LaMAR 50 phone videos, CroCoDL phone/robot sequences, 55 ETH3D-SLAM sequences and 11 EuRoC sequences; calibrated and uncalibrated protocols

vidmap.evaluation: LaMAR 50 phone videos, CroCoDL phone/robot sequences, 55 ETH3D-SLAM sequences and 11 EuRoC sequences; calibrated and uncalibrated protocols
vidmap.robotPlatform: Capture / reconstruction reference; no robot policy claim
vidmap.implementation: Dense warp chaining, covariance-aware sparse tracks, loop-closure provenance losses and global SfM/BA with depth priors
vidmap.limitations: Heavy extraction and global optimization; geometric precision remains below strict VI tolerances and very long sequences still drift. No direct UMI deployment verified.

mp-sfm.robotPlatform: Capture / reconstruction reference; no robot policy claim
mp-sfm.implementation: Uncertainty propagation, surface-prior residuals, depth-consistency checks, sparse/dense matching and COLMAP-based mapping
mp-sfm.limitations: Over-confident depth uncertainty, unreliable outdoor normals, image retrieval symmetries and extremely low overlap remain limits; added computation. A capture reference, not verified UMI adoption.

lamaria.summary: Benchmarks wearable VI trajectories with surveyed city-scale control points and an offline pose-refinement toolkit.

ghost-hoi.summary: Fits hand and unknown-object Gaussian discs with geometric priors and grasp-aware alignment.
ghost-hoi.input: Monocular RGB interaction video; masks, SfM and initialized hand estimates
ghost-hoi.output: Animatable hand/object surfaces and interaction poses
ghost-hoi.supervision: Per-video rendering, geometric-prior consistency and grasp alignment
ghost-hoi.outputRepresentation: Dense 2D Gaussian discs for hand and object
ghost-hoi.coordinateFrame: SfM reconstruction and hand/object canonical frames
ghost-hoi.scale: Refined object scale relative to initialized hand geometry
ghost-hoi.evaluation: HO3D, ARCTIC and captured hand-object videos
ghost-hoi.limitations: SfM and hand initialization remain inputs; Gaussian completion is not a scanned object or independently measured scale.
ghost-hoi.implementation: Runnable preprocessing/reconstruction repository; no explicit root code license verified.
ghost-hoi.robotEvidence: Reconstruction benchmarks; no robot policy evaluation

grasp-in-gaussians.summary: Tracks hand-object interaction efficiently using compact Gaussian mixtures initialized by foundation models.
grasp-in-gaussians.input: Monocular RGB video; DA3 geometry, Dyn-HaMR hands and SAM-3D object priors
grasp-in-gaussians.output: Refined hand trajectory, object geometry and 6D motion
grasp-in-gaussians.supervision: Pretrained priors; geometric and inferred-contact optimization
grasp-in-gaussians.target: Rigid hand-object interactions over long sequences
grasp-in-gaussians.outputRepresentation: Compact Sum-of-Gaussians plus MANO hand motion
grasp-in-gaussians.scale: Predicted camera/pointmap geometry; no measured depth required
grasp-in-gaussians.temporal: Sequence tracking and motion refinement after initialization
grasp-in-gaussians.limitations: Depends on initialization and foundation-model/contact predictions. Reported tracker efficiency excludes some model-preprocessing cost.
grasp-in-gaussians.implementation: MIT reconstruction source; SAM3, SAM-3D, Dyn-HaMR and other assets have separate terms.
grasp-in-gaussians.robotEvidence: Reconstruction benchmarks; no robot policy evaluation

forehoi.summary: Reconstructs held-object geometry from RGB video using joint 2D mask and 3D shape completion.
forehoi.output: Completed object geometry; supporting object masks/poses
forehoi.supervision: Synthetic hand-object videos with comprehensive 2D/3D annotations
forehoi.coordinateFrame: Object-centric canonical reconstruction; estimated per-view object pose
forehoi.scale: Normalized generated object; no independent metric world trajectory
forehoi.temporal: Feed-forward multi-frame aggregation; separate pose alignment
forehoi.evaluation: HO3D-v3 short clips; six HOT3D clips (5–15 frames); in-the-wild examples
forehoi.limitations: Object reconstruction is its principal output, not a complete joint hand-motion or robot-control system.
forehoi.implementation: MIT inference/training source, HF checkpoints and synthetic dataset; upstream models separately licensed.
forehoi.robotEvidence: Reconstruction benchmarks; no robot policy evaluation

follow-my-hold.summary: Guides object diffusion with hand geometry and image cues to recover plausible hand-object meshes.
follow-my-hold.input: Single RGB hand-object image; estimated normals, depth, masks and hand
follow-my-hold.output: Detailed object geometry and aligned hand-object meshes
follow-my-hold.supervision: Pretrained generative object model; inference-time geometric guidance
follow-my-hold.outputRepresentation: Generated object mesh and optimized hand/object transforms
follow-my-hold.scale: Inferred depth/normal and hand priors; no measured metric guarantee
follow-my-hold.evaluation: HO3D and in-the-wild single-image interaction reconstruction
follow-my-hold.limitations: Uses inferred normal/depth cues; contact plausibility does not prove observed force or physical correctness.
follow-my-hold.implementation: MIT full source; Hunyuan3D, HaMeR, MANO and other acknowledged components separately licensed.
follow-my-hold.robotEvidence: Reconstruction benchmarks; no robot policy evaluation

arthoi.summary: Combines foundation models, scale refinement and contact reasoning for hand-articulated-object video reconstruction.
arthoi.input: Single monocular RGB video of articulated-object manipulation
arthoi.output: Articulated object parts/motion, hand pose and interaction alignment
arthoi.supervision: Foundation priors; geometric optimization and MLLM contact reasoning
arthoi.outputRepresentation: Part-wise 4D object reconstruction and hand/object poses
arthoi.coordinateFrame: Shared reconstruction frame with estimated pose and scale
arthoi.scale: Predicted metric-depth pointcloud initializes/refines object size
arthoi.temporal: Part-wise motion reconstruction and sequence alignment
arthoi.evaluation: Articulated HOI videos and authors’ ArtHOI benchmark
arthoi.limitations: Metric depth and contact are model estimates. Articulated geometry and camera-motion errors can propagate across stages.
arthoi.implementation: Public source and HF dataset; explicit root software license not verified.
arthoi.robotEvidence: Reconstruction benchmarks; no robot policy evaluation

choir.summary: Rectifies open-world hand-object placement with generative depth correction and contact-aware optimization.
choir.input: Monocular RGB interaction video and inferred hand/object/camera priors
choir.output: 4D hand/object geometry, pose trajectories and geometric contact evidence
choir.supervision: Synthetic GraspPair flow prior; visual/geometric/contact optimization
choir.target: Primarily one hand and one rigid object
choir.outputRepresentation: MANO motion, object mesh/6D poses and contact correspondences
choir.coordinateFrame: Shared reconstruction frame from initialized camera and object geometry
choir.scale: MoGe-2 predicted metric depth and hand-size/geometric alignment
choir.temporal: Three-stage sequence reconstruction and contact-aware temporal refinement
choir.evaluation: HO3D, TasteRob and in-house open-world video examples
choir.limitations: Contact is geometrically inferred, not sensed. Bimanual extensions lack guaranteed joint global consistency.
choir.implementation: MIT three-stage source, release assets/checkpoints and 102 demo videos; third-party licenses separate.
choir.robotEvidence: Reconstruction benchmarks; no robot policy evaluation

agile-hoi.summary: Generates textured object meshes and tracks contact-consistent interaction without SfM initialization.
agile-hoi.input: Monocular RGB interaction video; segmentation, predicted metric depth and generative priors
agile-hoi.output: Textured object mesh, 6D poses and hand-object motion
agile-hoi.outputRepresentation: Watertight object mesh, MANO motion and real-to-sim retargeting
agile-hoi.coordinateFrame: Camera frame as world in the main static-camera setting
agile-hoi.scale: MoGe-2 predicted metric depth; camera/hand alignment
agile-hoi.temporal: Anchor-and-track sequence initialization, then contact-aware optimization
agile-hoi.evaluation: HO3D, DexYCB, in-the-wild videos and simulation retargeting
agile-hoi.limitations: Main pipeline assumes static cameras; dynamic-camera extensions require additional camera estimation. Real-to-sim replay is not a real closed-loop policy.
agile-hoi.implementation: Custom non-commercial research license; October source/data release starts with 18 prepared HO3D sequences.
agile-hoi.robotEvidence: Reconstruction benchmarks; no robot policy evaluation

magichoi.summary: Uses novel-view diffusion priors and visible contact to complete objects in short hand-interaction clips.
magichoi.input: Short monocular RGB interaction video with initialized camera/hand poses
magichoi.output: Hand/object surfaces and aligned interaction pose
magichoi.supervision: Novel-view synthesis prior; image rendering and visible-contact optimization
magichoi.outputRepresentation: Neural implicit object surface and MANO hand sequence
magichoi.scale: Initialized hand-model and optimized object-relative size
magichoi.evaluation: HO3D and captured in-the-wild short videos
magichoi.limitations: Short clips and COLMAP initialization can fail with severe ego-camera motion; generated unseen surfaces are prior-based.
magichoi.implementation: Apache-2.0 source and custom-video pipeline; external diffusion and MANO assets separately licensed.
magichoi.robotEvidence: Reconstruction benchmarks; no robot policy evaluation

bigs.summary: Jointly reconstructs two hands and an unknown object with Gaussian splatting and diffusion priors.
bigs.input: Monocular bimanual RGB video with preprocessed hand/object initialization
bigs.output: Two hand surfaces, unknown object geometry and interaction poses
bigs.supervision: Rendering losses; diffusion SDS and interacting-subject refinement
bigs.outputRepresentation: Shared hand Gaussian representation and object 3D Gaussians
bigs.scale: MANO/initialization scale and optimized object alignment
bigs.temporal: Per-sequence single-subject then joint Gaussian fitting
bigs.limitations: SfM and hand initialization remain necessary; Gaussian completion does not give independently measured object geometry.
bigs.implementation: MIT core source; preprocessing, MANO and diffusion dependencies separately licensed.
bigs.robotEvidence: Reconstruction benchmarks; no robot policy evaluation

easyhoi.summary: Combines segmentation, inpainting and object generation with prior-guided hand-object alignment.
easyhoi.output: Object geometry and physically constrained hand-object mesh alignment
easyhoi.supervision: Off-the-shelf visual/generative priors; image and geometric optimization
easyhoi.outputRepresentation: Generated object mesh, MANO hand mesh and optimized transforms
easyhoi.coordinateFrame: Input camera and reconstructed object/hand frames
easyhoi.scale: Hand-model/generative priors and optimized relative placement
easyhoi.evaluation: ARCTIC, OakInk, DexYCB and diverse in-the-wild images
easyhoi.limitations: No temporal tracking or independently measured shape/scale; inpainting may hallucinate hidden object regions.
easyhoi.implementation: MIT source; MANO and pretrained inpainting/3D-generation models separately licensed.
easyhoi.robotEvidence: Reconstruction benchmarks; no robot policy evaluation

diffhoi.summary: Fits hand-object video using diffusion priors over object renderings conditioned on hand articulation and category.
diffhoi.input: Monocular RGB clip, hand/object masks and object-category text
diffhoi.output: Object implicit surface, time-varying hand articulation and relative motion
diffhoi.supervision: Conditional diffusion prior; video reprojection and SDS
diffhoi.outputRepresentation: Object SDF, MANO mesh sequence and relative camera/hand/object transforms
diffhoi.coordinateFrame: Object- and hand-centric frames with optimized camera transforms
diffhoi.scale: Monocular hand-model/optimization scale; no independent metric scene anchor
diffhoi.evaluation: HOI4D across six object categories; first/third-person YouTube clips
diffhoi.limitations: Category-conditioned prior and uncertain initialization can limit unseen object shapes; hidden surfaces are inferred.
diffhoi.implementation: MIT repository and reconstruction/checkpoint links; inherited rendering/model terms separate.
diffhoi.robotEvidence: Reconstruction benchmarks; no robot policy evaluation

ihoi.summary: Uses hand articulation to reconstruct an unknown held object as a hand-centric signed-distance field.
ihoi.input: Single RGB hand-object image and estimated hand articulation
ihoi.output: Generic held-object shape; optional hand-pose refinement
ihoi.supervision: 3D shape/interaction supervision and articulation-conditioned implicit modeling
ihoi.outputRepresentation: Articulation-conditioned object SDF and hand mesh
ihoi.scale: Normalized shape/hand prior; not a measured world trajectory
ihoi.limitations: Single-view occlusions and hand-pose errors affect shape. A reconstructed contact does not imply tactile/force observation.
ihoi.implementation: Public demo/training source and checkpoint links; explicit root license not verified.
ihoi.robotEvidence: Reconstruction benchmarks; no robot policy evaluation

cpf.summary: Learns contact correspondences and refines hand-object poses with a spring-based potential field.
cpf.input: RGB image, known object geometry and initialized hand-object estimates
cpf.output: Refined hand/object pose and geometric contact alignment
cpf.supervision: Pose/contact labels; learned contact affinity and fitting
cpf.outputRepresentation: Contact-potential field, anatomical hand model and object pose
cpf.scale: Known object dimensions and hand-model geometry
cpf.temporal: Image-wise learning and pose fitting; not sequence tracking
cpf.evaluation: First-person FHB and HO3D interaction benchmarks
cpf.limitations: Requires object geometry. Virtual spring forces are an optimization representation, not measured contact forces.
cpf.implementation: Public training/evaluation/optimization source and HF assets; no explicit root code license verified.
cpf.robotEvidence: Reconstruction benchmarks; no robot policy evaluation

toch.summary: Denoises object-to-hand correspondences to refine implausible hand-object motion sequences.
toch.input: Noisy 3D hand mesh sequence and a known rigid-object mesh/pose
toch.supervision: GRAB motion-capture prior with synthetic pose/translation perturbations
toch.outputRepresentation: Object-centric dense correspondence field and fitted MANO motion
toch.coordinateFrame: Local object frame; object treated as fixed in that frame
toch.scale: Inherited from supplied object and hand geometry
toch.temporal: Temporal denoising autoencoder and sequence fitting
toch.evaluation: Perturbed GRAB; HO3D and RGB/RGB-D tracker refinement
toch.limitations: This is a 3D refinement stage, not a raw RGB/RGB-D tracker; assumes a known object mesh and handles one hand/rigid object.
toch.implementation: Public training/GRAB inference code; custom-data path TODO; no explicit root code license verified.
toch.robotEvidence: Reconstruction benchmarks; no robot policy evaluation

pressurevision.summary: Infers planar hand pressure from RGB appearance; an adjacent foundation for egocentric touch estimation.
pressurevision.robotEvidence: Perception / reconstruction; no robot policy demonstrated
pressurevision.scale: Pressure magnitude supervised by a physical array; no shear force
pressurevision.evaluation: Held-out people in PressureVisionDB; RGB / lighting generalization

pressurevision-plus-plus.summary: Learns fingertip pressure from measured pressure and prompted weak contact labels on diverse surfaces.
pressurevision-plus-plus.supervision: Instrumented pressure plus prompted finger / force-level weak labels
pressurevision-plus-plus.robotEvidence: Perception / reconstruction; no robot policy demonstrated
pressurevision-plus-plus.scale: Weak force categories complement measured pressure; no measured force at inference
pressurevision-plus-plus.evaluation: 51 participants across diverse objects and surfaces; mixed-reality interface
pressurevision-plus-plus.dateNote: Original v1 title: Visual Estimation of Fingertip Pressure on Diverse Surfaces using Easily Captured Data; current author project uses PressureVision++.

hope.summary: Combines RGB video and reconstructed hand geometry to predict contact and normal pressure on MANO vertices.
hope.input: Monocular RGB clip with HaWoR-estimated MANO; frozen DINOv3 features
hope.supervision: Glove pressure, planar pressure and contact-only HOI labels
hope.robotEvidence: Perception / reconstruction; no robot policy demonstrated
hope.scale: Predicted normal pressure in kPa, supervised by sensor labels; not measured touch
hope.limitations: Pressure loss is masked on contact-only samples. Results depend on estimated hand geometry; force-vector visualizations aggregate predicted pressure-derived values.

contactopt.summary: Refines a reconstructed hand pose by matching predicted hand-object contact with differentiable geometry.
contactopt.input: Initial MANO hand mesh and object mesh
contactopt.supervision: ContactPose contact supervision; differentiable contact optimization
contactopt.robotEvidence: Reconstruction / human grasp preference; no executable robot policy
contactopt.scale: Inherits input geometry units; contact values are not pressure or force
contactopt.evaluation: Perturbed ContactPose and image-derived poses; contact / kinematic metrics

egopressure.summary: Estimates hand pressure from RGB and hand geometry, separating reference-pose and image-estimated-pose protocols.
egopressure.input: RGB with hand geometry; optimized reference-pose benchmark and HaMeR-derived-pose variant
egopressure.output: Hand-mesh UV pressure and image-space reprojection
egopressure.supervision: Measured touchpad pressure; multiview hand reconstruction labels
egopressure.robotEvidence: Perception / reconstruction; no robot policy demonstrated
egopressure.outputRepresentation: Hand-mesh UV pressure and image-space reprojection
egopressure.scale: Pressure calibrated on an instrumented plane; arbitrary-object performance is qualitative
egopressure.evaluation: EgoPressure held-out participants; reference versus HaMeR pose conditions; qualitative unseen-object transfer
egopressure.limitations: Reference-pose benchmark conditions use capture annotations. HaMeR-derived poses support an image-based variant; those results are separate. PressureFormer UV outputs are documented by the current author project.

egotactile.summary: Adapts video diffusion to generate full-hand grasp pressure with visual, text and prototype conditioning.
egotactile.input: Egocentric RGB video, hand mask, physical-attribute text and prototype heatmap
egotactile.supervision: Paired tactile glove recordings; weakly paired bare-hand transfer
egotactile.robotEvidence: Perception / reconstruction; no robot policy demonstrated
egotactile.scale: Pressure learned from tactile measurements; appearance alone does not identify object load
egotactile.temporal: Stable Video Diffusion; prototype and text feature rectification
egotactile.evaluation: EgoTactile; weakly paired bare-hand and unseen-object transfer
egotactile.limitations: Physical-attribute text and a constructed hand-pressure prototype condition inference; not a glove measurement or a guarantee of the true load.

egotouch.summary: Fuses egocentric and optional wrist views to predict bimanual contact pressure.
egotouch.input: Egocentric RGB, optional wrist RGB, and 42 WiLoR-estimated hand joints
egotouch.robotEvidence: Perception / reconstruction; no robot policy demonstrated
egotouch.scale: Pressure prediction supervised by real tactile sensing; no tactile input at inference
egotouch.temporal: 8-frame clips with interval 2; cross-view attention and view dropout
egotouch.evaluation: EgoTouch tasks; ego-only versus wrist-assisted prediction
egotouch.limitations: Ego-only refers to camera views. The baseline also uses WiLoR-estimated 3D hand joints; pressure is predicted, not measured at inference.

honnotate.summary: Jointly fits hand and known-object poses over RGB-D video to annotate interaction sequences.
honnotate.input: One or several calibrated RGB-D camera sequences; known object mesh and hand model
honnotate.output: Sequence-aligned 3D hand and object pose annotations
honnotate.supervision: Silhouette, measured depth, 2D keypoints, geometric and temporal objectives
honnotate.robotEvidence: Annotation / hand-pose benchmarks; no robot policy
honnotate.outputRepresentation: MANO pose/shape, hand vertices/joints and object 6D pose
honnotate.scale: Measured RGB-D and known object geometry; hand pose is model-fitted
honnotate.evaluation: HO-3D pose annotation and occlusion-robust single-image hand baseline
honnotate.implementation: GPL-3.0 annotation source implements the single-RGB-D-camera setting; separate HO-3D viewer/evaluation repository.
honnotate.limitations: Released annotation code assumes marginal grasp change in the single-camera setting. Full paper also studies a multi-camera setting; fitted poses are estimates, not marker-mocap measurements.

hand2robot.summary: Turns RGB-D human demonstrations into object-consistent action labels for dexterous robot policy post-training.
hand2robot.input: Human RGB-D task videos and camera intrinsics; limited target-robot demonstrations
hand2robot.output: Retargeted robot-action supervision and a post-trained dexterous policy
hand2robot.supervision: Foundation-model initialization, object-local contact / image fitting; mixed human and robot action supervision
hand2robot.robotEvidence: Real Franka arm + xHand; Place Vase, Open Box and Insert Toast
hand2robot.target: Dexterous hand-arm robot supervision from human demonstrations
hand2robot.outputRepresentation: Reconstructed MANO / object trajectories; 18-D relative arm and xHand action offsets
hand2robot.coordinateFrame: Camera → MapAnything-estimated world → robot via initial-object alignment and hand-eye calibration
hand2robot.scale: RGB-D and camera intrinsics; generated metric object geometry; calibrated robot-domain alignment
hand2robot.temporal: Per-clip object-trajectory selection, staged hand optimization and GeoRT retargeting
hand2robot.evaluation: DexYCB, HO3D-v3; three real tasks, 20 trials each; target-task π0.5 post-training
hand2robot.implementation: Public primary paper; linked project website currently returns 404, and no runnable code/weights verified.
hand2robot.limitations: Real-robot human and robot data share a fixed side-view camera setup, so this is adjacent to ego capture, not demonstrated in-the-wild ego transfer. RGB-D is an input, and the policy still uses limited robot data.

ego2contact.input: Egocentric RGB clips; paired touch measurements for training
ego2contact.robotEvidence: Simulation RL and real-robot policy post-training; real rollouts use measured glove touch
ego2contact.limitations: Predicted touch labels are used in post-training; real rollouts still receive measured glove touch. Visual predictions are not tactile measurements.
ego2contact.supervision: Human vision-touch pairs and robot tactile adaptation
ego2contact.summary: Transfers visual touch priors from human hands to robot tactile layouts.
ego2contact.policyInput: Simulation: predicted touch. Real rollouts: RGB, robot state, instruction and measured tactile-glove input.
ego2contact.coordinateFrame: Canonical anatomical regions; robot taxels mapped by correspondence
ego2contact.temporal: Temporal RGB context with hand-local visual features
ego2contact.evaluation: Human held-out data; four simulated and two real-world tasks
ego2contact.robotPlatform: xArm6 and BrainCo Revo 2 with a tactile glove

p3-wam.input: Egocentric RGB; language and optional goal image
p3-wam.robotEvidence: Two physical execution experiments with retargeted open-loop trajectories
p3-wam.limitations: Robot evaluation uses open-loop replay, not a feedback policy. Monocular global hand position remains ambiguous.
p3-wam.summary: Jointly reconstructs hand motion, predicts video and plans action-video sequences.
p3-wam.scale: Monocular global hand placement remains ambiguous
p3-wam.evaluation: Hand reconstruction, action-conditioned prediction and goal-conditioned planning; two physical replay experiments

egomatrix.output: Robot trajectories and paired rendered robot observations
egomatrix.robotEvidence: Simulation task transfer and real-world trajectory replay
egomatrix.limitations: Real-robot evidence is trajectory replay; no closed-loop visuomotor policy is established. Relative contact geometry is prioritized over exact metric scene recovery.
egomatrix.supervision: HOI reconstruction; retargeting and simulation RL
egomatrix.summary: Converts human videos into contact-aware robot trajectories and paired rendered observations.
egomatrix.outputRepresentation: Retargeted joint trajectories and paired rendered observations
egomatrix.scale: Relative hand-object geometry and contact; not exact metric scene recovery
egomatrix.temporal: Sequence reconstruction, retargeting and observation synthesis
egomatrix.robotPlatform: Dual UR5e with XHand; RB-Y1 replay

egoreveal.input: RGB view and camera-arm pose; object keypoints and command history
egoreveal.limitations: Switches between two task-specific policies based on target visibility; does not establish general in-the-wild transfer.
egoreveal.summary: Learns viewpoint repositioning and manipulation from human ego demonstrations under occlusion.
egoreveal.outputRepresentation: Camera-arm pose sequence and manipulation commands
egoreveal.evaluation: Partial-occlusion real-robot tasks and unseen occlusion scenarios

egolap.input: Human/robot images, instructions and robot state
egolap.output: Reasoning, language actions and robot action chunks
egolap.limitations: The project marks code and checkpoints as coming soon; release is not verified.
egolap.supervision: Human and robot trajectories with language-action supervision
egolap.summary: Aligns human and robot experience through language actions and motion-level reasoning.
egolap.outputRepresentation: Language-action reasoning plus robot control chunks

ego4wam.input: Human egocentric and robot video; action labels when available
ego4wam.output: World-action policy and predicted visual dynamics
ego4wam.limitations: Reported data scale is a training mixture, not a newly released standalone corpus.
ego4wam.summary: Studies alignment, task coverage, supervision and use of human data under a fixed world-action model.
ego4wam.outputRepresentation: World-action policy with shared action interfaces
ego4wam.implementation: Base/Joint model, four RoboDojo post-training recipes and local evaluation sources verified; Ego4WAM additions MIT, upstream notices remain separate. Two actual safetensors bundles verified: video-pretrained initialization and RoboDojo-posttrained Joint policy. Apache-2.0 card; component/bundle terms remain separate. Human-video pretraining, internal experiments and other StarVLA backends are not included; reported human data scale is not a new public corpus.

lambda0.input: Egocentric video with synchronized human body/hand motion; robot data
lambda0.robotEvidence: Real G1 loco-manipulation and RoboDojo evaluation; no target-task robot demonstrations for demonstrated human-to-humanoid zero-shot transfer.
lambda0.limitations: Four alignment-example trajectories and release assets are available. HumanVerse-500 and pretraining datasets are not included; linked sample Hub returned HTTP 401. Actual OpenLambda alignment, Stage I/II model-training and human GoPro/PICO collection/sync/resampling sources verified; Apache-2.0. Complete Stage III evaluation/deployment, robot recording alignment and conversion remain unreleased.
lambda0.supervision: Human hand pretraining, whole-body mid-training and robot post-training
lambda0.summary: Transfers hand interaction and whole-body human capture to a humanoid VLA through staged training.
lambda0.outputRepresentation: Whole-body humanoid actions with embodiment-specific interfaces
lambda0.evaluation: SIMPLE, real G1 loco-manipulation, and new-report RoboDojo study
lambda0.implementation: Actual OpenLambda alignment, Stage I/II model-training and human GoPro/PICO collection/sync/resampling sources verified; Apache-2.0. Complete Stage III evaluation/deployment, robot recording alignment and conversion remain unreleased. Actual lambda0-midtrain-100k model.safetensors verified; Apache-2.0; Stage II initialization, not a fully deployed Stage III policy.

zeva-ego.input: Egocentric videos, robot demonstrations and action-effect context
zeva-ego.limitations: Reported training-corpus hours do not imply a new public dataset. In-context gains depend on repeated interaction context.
zeva-ego.supervision: Human-video action pseudo-labels and robot training
zeva-ego.summary: Combines action-centered human-video mid-training with deployment-time interaction memory.
zeva-ego.outputRepresentation: Action-centered video latents and context-conditioned robot actions
zeva-ego.implementation: Apache-2.0 Zeva-Ego branch: visual action encoder training/inference, RoboTwin policies and real-robot integration utilities; Gemma/dependency terms separate.

simdex.input: Human egocentric samples and target robot demonstrations
simdex.output: Selected human training samples and dexterous VLA policy
simdex.limitations: Large sample-pool counts are training/discovery scale, not verified downloadable data. Architecture is unchanged.
simdex.supervision: Morphology-agnostic action matching and video reranking
simdex.summary: Selects task-relevant human clips for dexterous VLA training through similarity-based mining.
simdex.outputRepresentation: Task-selected human clips and dexterous VLA control

egojepa.summary: Learns effect-aware latent actions from human video, then adapts them to robot control.
egojepa.input: Egocentric RGB and hand-motion differences for pretraining; robot data for adapters
egojepa.output: Latent actions, visual predictions and embodiment-specific robot control
egojepa.outputRepresentation: Effect-aware latent actions with lightweight control adapters
egojepa.robotEvidence: Five real-world tasks across three robot embodiments
egojepa.evaluation: Real-robot in-domain and out-of-domain policy evaluation
egojepa.supervision: JEPA visual prediction, joint world modeling and robot-specific tuning
egojepa.limitations: Avoids rule-based human-to-robot retargeting but still uses hand-motion differences and robot adaptation data.

dexoak.summary: Learns object-aware kinematic references that preserve human hand–object interaction geometry.
dexoak.input: Human mocap keypoints and object point clouds
dexoak.limitations: Physical replays are not closed-loop visual-policy learning.
dexoak.supervision: See primary method and training protocol.

egorayformer.summary: Refines wearer body pose using shared stereo hypotheses and ray-space geometry.
egorayformer.limitations: Device-relative coordinates; stereo constraints do not make every monocular prediction a depth measurement.
egorayformer.supervision: See primary method and training protocol.

anchorflow-vio.summary: Provides a frozen Basalt-derived monocular VIO configuration and reproducible LaMAria evaluation.
anchorflow-vio.input: One grayscale camera and one IMU
anchorflow-vio.limitations: Odometry rather than a full loop-closing SLAM system; start sensitivity and one divergent training sequence are reported.
anchorflow-vio.supervision: See primary method and training protocol.
anchorflow-vio.implementation: Source adaptation and reproducible tools verified; original code MIT, Basalt/upstream terms remain separate.

slam.calibration: Factory IMU correction, calibrated camera/IMU, fixed timing adjustment and sufficient initialization motion.
slam.metricScale: Inertial physical-scale constraints; no measured depth input.
slam.captureRelevance: Direct LaMAria wearable-glasses evaluation; monocular grayscale + IMU pipeline.

anchorflow-vio.scale: Inertial physical-scale constraints; no measured depth input.

ssio.summary: Trains inertial odometry from short-window IMU integration and pose-graph distillation.
ssio.input: Calibrated IMU; attitude for teacher gravity compensation
ssio.robotEvidence: Six datasets across pedestrians, drones, quadrupeds and a humanoid
ssio.limitations: Models are trained separately per platform; reference attitude and estimated attitude regimes must be distinguished.
ssio.supervision: See primary method and training protocol.
ssio.evaluation: Six datasets across pedestrians, drones, quadrupeds and a humanoid

sources.label: Primary v1 method, affiliations and evaluation

slam.calibration: Calibrated IMU; teacher gravity compensation requires reference or estimated attitude; per-platform training.
slam.metricScale: Calibrated inertial integration, with attitude sensitivity.
slam.captureRelevance: Body-worn pedestrian inertial data among six evaluation datasets; signal-only capture reference.

ssio.scale: Calibrated inertial integration, with attitude sensitivity.

acts.summary: Learns action-conditioned visual and tactile dynamics only from human physical interaction.
acts.input: Wrist and scene RGB, GelSight images, sensor motion and tactile-derived normal force
acts.robotEvidence: Held-out human prediction and prediction on robot teleoperation rollouts
acts.limitations: React is 4.9 hours reported across three objects. Robot-rollout prediction is not learned robot-policy deployment; force is inferred from tactile images.
acts.supervision: See primary method and training protocol.
acts.evaluation: Held-out human prediction and prediction on robot teleoperation rollouts

sources.label: Primary v1 method, affiliations and evaluation

mocap.summary: Uses spatial memory from passive human videos to guide an agent that writes mobile-manipulation code.
